scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace turnlet && npm run dev --workspace @turnlet/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace turnlet && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace turnlet && vitest run && npm run test:examples && npm run test:experiments
scripts.test:examples: npm run build --workspace turnlet && tsc -p examples/record-validation/tsconfig.json && node examples/record-validation/dist/run.js
scripts.test:package: npm run build --workspace turnlet && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
